Oh Story

网文写作 skill 包：扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面图一套流程，装进你正在用的编程 Agent。

项目主页  ·  在线写作工作台  ·  安装  ·  常见问题  ·  English

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f9cc11b-1fb8-4cc5-a084-e0deb05ec791 ## 这是什么 Oh Story 覆盖长篇与短篇网文全流程：**扫榜选材 → 拆解爆款 → 搭大纲写正文 → 去AI味 → 生成封面图**。它以 14 个 skill 的形式装进你正在用的编程 Agent，直接复用该工具的模型，无需显卡，也不用单独配模型。 - **用文件系统当记忆** — 设定、大纲、正文、追踪分目录保存，追踪数据统一记在 `追踪/_tracking-state.json` 里，自动生成状态卡、伏笔清单、角色状态与「作者真相 / 读者已知」双时间线；压缩上下文或换新会话后照样从文件接着写。 - **7 个专职角色与读写守卫** — 大纲、正文、一致性检查、人设、考据、书稿检索、拆书抽取各司其职；长篇缺细纲或上一章追踪未入账时先拦下，写完自动扫半截断章、大纲词漏入正文与常见 AI 腔（各 skill 按需加载参考资料，详见[架构与目录说明](docs/architecture.md)、[知识库清单](docs/knowledge-base.md)）。 - **适配 7 款编程 Agent** — Claude Code · Codex CLI · Google Antigravity · OpenCode · ZCode · OpenClaw · Reasonix；支持子代理与 hooks 的工具由 `/story-setup` 自动部署，其他能读项目文件的通用 Agent 环境也能按 skill 流程直接用。 - **面向主流长短篇平台** — 长篇覆盖起点中文网、番茄小说、晋江文学城、七猫小说、刺猬猫；短篇覆盖知乎盐言故事、番茄短篇、七猫短篇。 > **套路 = 确定性的情绪满足** 先**扫榜**摸清题材风口、人设与开篇切入点，再**拆文**扒出爆款的黄金三章、爽点节奏与钩子写法，最后用钩子、爽点和期待感搭自己的书。剧情走向由作者拍板，Agent 按敲定的方案推进。 ## 安装 ```bash npx skills add zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode -y -g ``` `-g` 全局安装，所有目录可用；去掉 `-g` 只装到当前目录。**更新时重新执行同一条命令即可。** 也可以直接对编程 Agent 说一句话（支持导入 GitHub 仓库或 skill 的工具都适用，例如 WorkBuddy，见社区写的[开书实操](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2087452622655592204)）： ``` 安装这个 skill https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode ``` 装好后，在写作项目根目录运行 `/story-setup`（Codex 用 `$story-setup`）部署当前工具支持的 hooks、子代理与参考资料，**随后新开会话**。也可在 [ClawHub](https://clawhub.ai/) 查找，发布范围见 [ClawHub 发布清单](.clawhub/publish.json)。 > 各编程 Agent 的部署差异、已知限制与安装排查（Windows `ENOENT`、Antigravity `agy -p`、旧目录残留等）见 **[部署与安装排查](docs/hosts.md)**。版本记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) 和 [Releases](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/releases)，旧项目更新见[升级指南](skills/story-setup/UPGRADING.md)。 ## 看看实际效果 以下示例均来自 skill 真实运行产出（外加一段专门构造的 AI 腔反例），完整文件见 **[demo/](demo/README.md)**。 ### 续写状态卡：连载几百章不崩盘 以作者自己的长篇为例：先用 `/story-import` 把已发布的 20 章整理成连载工程，开写第 21 章前的 `追踪/上下文.md` 如下。动笔前只挑本章用得上的状态，连同本章细纲、相关设定与出场角色卡交给写手，不把整张状态卡塞进提示词： ```markdown ## 当前位置 - 当前章：第20章 卷：第一卷·军宣整顿 故事时间：《如愿》点击破亿后的第二天 ## 长期约束 - 军宣爽点必须通过作品效果、传播数据和围观反应链兑现，不能只靠系统播报。 - 钟嘉嘉未公开的军方培养安排属于作者真相，正文揭示前不能当成读者已知。 ## 活跃伏笔 - F016｜钟嘉嘉并非普通军报实习生，她的军方家庭背景仍未完全公开｜埋第7章｜回收章未定｜高 - F049｜吴伟收到寻衅滋事公诉通知，最终法律结果尚未落地｜埋第18章｜回收章未定｜高 - F054｜一位老兵邀请江晨上门听当年的故事，为后续创作提供入口｜埋第20章｜回收章未定｜高 ## 下一章承诺 - 先补第21章细纲，再承接老兵邀请、新歌伴奏和钢琴能力。 ``` **「作者真相」与「读者已知」分开记录**，防止角色未卜先知或提前漏出伏笔。完整文件：[`demo/长篇/.../追踪/上下文.md`](demo/长篇/让你管账号，你高燃混剪炸全网/追踪/上下文.md) ### 续写第 21 章：从补细纲、写正文到追踪回写 顶部视频录的就是这次运行——`/story-long-write 写第21章` 一次跑完的产出与检查： ```text 细纲 细纲_第021章.md 追踪里写着「第21章尚无细纲」，skill 先补纲：单元 L1-03、目标情绪、本章标价、闭环状态、10 个情节点四列表格（外加可选的展开粒度列） 章级检查 storyctl.py chapter check ready · 字数 2068 / 目标 2300 ├ check-ai-patterns.js 0 命中 ├ check-degeneration.js 0 命中 └ normalize-punctuation 0 命中 追踪提交 storyctl.py chapter commit tracking_committed=true · state_revision 0 → 1 追踪文件 tracking_commit.py check 上下文.md / 伏笔.md / 角色状态/ / 时间线/ / 逐章记录/ 全部由 state 重生成，逐字一致 ``` 细纲通过校验后，`narrative-writer` 分两段写完正文，核对设定与伏笔、按需去味润色，再跑完收尾检查。提交后，所有追踪文件都从 `_tracking-state.json` 自动重生成，不用手动维护；对照写前状态卡，本章实际回写了这些变化（节选）： ```diff ## 当前位置 -- 当前章：第20章 场景：火箭军文工团，钟嘉嘉送来老兵书法礼后 +- 当前章：第21章 场景：火箭军文工团办公室，江晨收到谭守义地址回信后 ## 活跃伏笔 -- F054｜一位老兵邀请江晨上门听当年的故事，为后续创作提供入口｜埋第20章｜回收章未定｜高 +- F054｜谭守义已给邻市地址，江晨定次日上门听故事｜埋第20章｜第22章｜高 +- F057｜谭守义有个讲了五十年没人听全过的故事，内容未揭示｜埋第21章｜第22章｜高 +- F058｜任务三：离别主题作品、开放日当天热度1000万+、限时14天｜埋第21章｜第27章｜高 ## 下一章承诺 -- 先补第21章细纲，再承接老兵邀请、新歌伴奏和钢琴能力。 +- 江晨向周薄森请假出营，赴邻市听谭守义讲完整故事并录音，揭示F057。 ## 连贯性风险 -- 第21章尚无细纲，不能直接写正文。 +- 谭守义故事的作者真相为候选（E015），作者可在第22章细纲前改；揭示前不当读者已知。 ``` 新出场的谭守义自动建好角色卡与状态文件；他那段未公开的往事作为候选真相（E015）记入 `时间线/作者真相.md`，`读者已知.md` 只留江晨读到的那句话，已解决的旧风险则归档进 `逐章记录/第021章.md`——**状态不会无声漏掉**。 成品：[`正文/第021章_离别怎么会开花.md`](demo/长篇/让你管账号，你高燃混剪炸全网/正文/第021章_离别怎么会开花.md) · [`大纲/细纲_第021章.md`](demo/长篇/让你管账号，你高燃混剪炸全网/大纲/细纲_第021章.md) · [`设定/角色/谭守义.md`](demo/长篇/让你管账号，你高燃混剪炸全网/设定/角色/谭守义.md) · [`追踪/逐章记录/第021章.md`](demo/长篇/让你管账号，你高燃混剪炸全网/追踪/逐章记录/第021章.md) ### 长篇拆文：打分给出具体依据 `/story-long-analyze` 拆解《盘龙》前 23 章（约 6.2 万字，仅作分析素材），按番茄男频升级流读者的阅读习惯打分： | 维度 | 评分 | 说明（节选） | |------|------|------| | 开篇钩子 | 2 | 前 500 字纯地理定位 + 晨练群像，无悬念 / 冲突 / 反差，靠「平民努力出头」慢渗。代入扎实但即时拉力弱。 | | 主角塑造 | 4 | 延迟点名（第 60 段才点名）+ 他人惊叹引出，「衰败贵族 + 六岁神童」反差立人设。三章里最强项。 | | 爽点设计 | 1 | 三章零传统爽点，爽感被刻意延迟到第 18 章金手指登场，赌代入复利。 | > **综合**：三章是「立人设强、给爽点零」的极端结构。直接照搬会劝退番茄读者， > 但拆出来的局部技法（导师代言设定、延迟点名、身体反应外化）高度可复用。 完整报告：[`demo/拆文库/盘龙/拆文报告.md`](demo/拆文库/盘龙/拆文报告.md) ### 短篇拆文：把旧作拆成可复用的结构 `/story-short-analyze` 拆解作者自己的短篇《曾将爱意私藏》（约 8,500 字，追妻火葬场 · 死遁），抽出 54 个情节节点与 11 项写作手法，逐段锚定原文并标出情绪走向（−9~+9）： | 原文 | 抽出的结构 | |---|---| | 「霍总还不打算让沈暮月母子进门吗？」
「没必要，私生子而已。」
我正准备推门而入，听到这话，手停在了半空。 | **N1 门口偷听到「私生子而已」**
类型{信息} · 情绪{震惊}{−7}
手法{开篇即冲突+信息差} | | 霍庭煜对我没有爱。
我默然抽回了手。
该放弃自己的执念了。 | **N2 认清对方无爱，决意放弃执念**
类型{情绪} · 情绪{心酸}{−5} | 同一份产出里，`写作手法.md` 直接点出原作的短板： > **第一人称视角的局限**：男主的转变缺少情节铺垫，到 N47 才靠大段内心独白把「早就原谅、夜不能寐、深爱」一次性倒出来， > 光靠心理说明，没用细节和行动演出来——这是第一人称追妻文的通病。 写新篇时，`/story-short-write` 直接调用这份报告、情节节点与手法卡构思。完整产出：[`demo/拆文库/曾将爱意私藏/`](demo/拆文库/曾将爱意私藏/) ### 去 AI 味：先跑句式扫描，再按语境改稿 `/story-deslop` 先用本地脚本扫描高频 AI 句式，标出行号、片段与改写方向。扫描一段人工构造的 AI 腔反例，共命中 8 处（3 处阻断 / 5 处建议）： ```text 改前.md:7:20 [blocking] em-dash (么叫做命运的安排——不是巧合，而是一) 改前.md:23:6 [blocking] trailer-ending (才刚刚开始) 改前.md:25:1 [blocking] trailer-ending (没人知道) 改前.md:7:22 [advisory] not-is-comparison (不是巧合，而是一种冥冥之中的注定) 改前.md:11:1 [advisory] negation-parade (没有犹豫，没有生涩，) 改前.md:19:3 [advisory] voice-contrast (声音不大，却) 改前.md:21:2 [advisory] not-is-comparison (不是一次简单的弹奏，而是一场蓄谋已久的惊艳亮相) 改前.md:3:1 [advisory] cliche-density-tic (仿佛 一丝 深吸一口气 缓缓 微微) ``` 第 21 章正文同一场戏跑同一套检查：**零命中，exit 0**。两段字数相近，改前用抽象判词替读者下结论，改后把人物的判断、对话和当场反应直接写出来。完整对照：**[demo/去AI味对照/](demo/去AI味对照/README.md)** ### 本地工作台与封面生成 运行 `/story dashboard`（Codex 用 `$story dashboard`）打开本地网页工作台，浏览拆文库与书稿目录，支持搜索、Markdown 预览、编辑保存与浅色/深色主题。服务仅监听 `127.0.0.1`，书稿不上传。 | 工作台 | `/story-cover` 生成的封面 | |---|---| | | | ## 安装后的第一条请求 复制对应的一条，把〈括号里的内容〉换成你的书即可开始： 1. **开一本新书（先盘黄金三章与人设）** > 我想开一本〈番茄男频都市脑洞 / 晋江古言穿书〉新书，核心卖点是〈一句话脑洞或金手指〉。先帮我理清已有的设定和还没定下来的地方，搭一个黄金三章的开篇框架（核心冲突、视角限制、前三章怎么起钩子和兑现爽点）。先别写正文，题材取舍、人物动机和后续走向等我拍板再动笔。 2. **导入已有书稿接着写** > 用 `/story-import` 把这份旧稿整理成连载项目。第 1–〈N〉章是定稿，〈文件名〉是第〈N+1〉章没写完的残稿；保留原稿别覆盖，残稿先别算正式章节，反推出来的人物设定和伏笔单列出来等我确认。先把章节范围、人物状态、前后矛盾的地方和待确认项列给我看，先不续写。 3. **改一段不得劲或 AI 味重的正文** > 用 `/story-deslop` 帮我改改这段戏，现在读着太〈水 / 像总结陈词 / 解释味太重〉了。别改剧情事实和人物当下知道的信息，也别提前漏出后面的伏笔；先挑出哪几句出戏，给一版改前改后对照和改法说明，不用全书通改，改哪几处由我定。 ## 流程总览 扫榜和拆文按需选用，已有脑洞可以直接聊人设和大纲；正式写正文前，先在项目根目录跑一次 `/story-setup`。 ```mermaid flowchart LR classDef entry fill:#f0f0f0,color:#333,stroke:#999,stroke-width:1px classDef phase fill:#e8f4fd,color:#1a1a2e,stroke:#4a9be8,stroke-width:1px classDef final fill:#fce4ec,color:#333,stroke:#e57373,stroke-width:1px entry_l{{"长篇作者"}}:::entry entry_s{{"短篇作者"}}:::entry entry_r{{"已有方向"}}:::entry entry_i{{"已有小说"}}:::entry subgraph S0 [" 环境部署"] setup["/story-setup"]:::phase end subgraph S1 [" 扫榜选材"] direction TB scan_l["长篇扫榜"]:::phase scan_s["短篇扫榜"]:::phase end subgraph S2 [" 拆文学习"] direction TB analyze_l["长篇拆文"]:::phase analyze_s["短篇拆文"]:::phase import_l["已有小说导入"]:::phase end subgraph S3 [" 落笔创作"] direction TB write_l["长篇写作"]:::phase write_s["短篇写作"]:::phase end subgraph S4 [" 精修定稿"] deslop["去 AI 味"]:::final end entry_l --> setup entry_s --> setup setup --> scan_l setup --> scan_s scan_l --> analyze_l scan_s --> analyze_s analyze_l --> write_l analyze_s --> write_s entry_r -.->|直接规划| write_l entry_r -.->|直接规划| write_s entry_i -.->|推荐先部署| setup setup -.->|逆向导入| import_l import_l -.->|续写| write_l write_l --> deslop write_s --> deslop ``` ## 常见问题 ### 已经写了一部分的小说，能导入后接着写吗？ 可以。先在项目根目录运行 `/story-setup` 并新开会话，再用 `/story-import` 把旧稿反向拆成设定、大纲和追踪文件；核对完反推结果后，长篇用 `/story-long-write 写第N章`（先补该章细纲再动笔），短篇补完构思即可续写。反推一律以原稿写明的内容为准，详见[旧稿导入与续写指南](https://zenstory.ai/zh/oh-story/import-and-continue)。 ### 长篇连载怎么避免前后矛盾、漏伏笔或角色未卜先知？ 项目把「作者真相」「读者已知」和角色当前状态分别存成文件，每章动笔前只挑本章用得上的状态与待回收伏笔交给写手，写完再由脚本统一回写到 `_tracking-state.json`。具体机制见[长篇人设与连贯性说明](docs/ai-long-novel-character-consistency.md)，三章连写实操见[长篇连载一致性指南](https://zenstory.ai/zh/oh-story/long-novel-continuity)。 ### 跑完 `/story-deslop` 去 AI 味，为什么外部检测器还可能标红？ `/story-deslop` 先用本地脚本清掉高频 AI 句式、破折号泛滥和复读截断，再由 Agent 顺着上下文把总结腔与空泛套话改回具体对话、判断和现场反应。目标是让读者读着自然不出戏，朱雀等外部检测工具仅作自测参考；具体改法见[去 AI 味文档](docs/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md)与[改稿指南](https://zenstory.ai/zh/oh-story/revise-ai-prose)。 ### Windows 上安装报 `ENOENT ... mkdir`，但最后显示 Done，算装好吗？ 说明部分 skill 没装全。直接重跑同一条安装命令即可自动补齐；若参考资料目录仍有缺漏，运行 `/story-setup` 时会明确报错提醒。Windows 上的 Codex 用户还需在 Git 中开启 `core.symlinks=true`。 ### 升级版本或换了编程 Agent 后要做什么？ 先重跑安装命令并新开会话。如果新版本改动了项目内的子代理、hooks 或参考资料包，或者你换了另一款编程 Agent，在写作项目根目录补跑一次 `/story-setup` 再新开会话即可；各版本要求见[升级指南](skills/story-setup/UPGRADING.md)。 ## Oh Story

A skill pack for writing Chinese web fiction: chart scanning, deconstruction, drafting, de-AI editing, and cover art inside the coding agent you already use.

Project page  ·  Web workbench  ·  Install  ·  FAQ  ·  中文

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f9cc11b-1fb8-4cc5-a084-e0deb05ec791 ## What it is Oh Story covers the full web-fiction workflow for both serials and short stories: **chart scanning → bestseller deconstruction → outlining and drafting → de-AI editing → cover art**. It installs as 14 skills inside the coding agent you already use and runs on that agent's model—no GPU and no separate model setup required. - **Files as memory** — settings, outlines, chapters, and continuity tracking live in separate directories, with `追踪/_tracking-state.json` as the single source of truth that generates the continuity card, foreshadowing ledger, character snapshots, and author-truth / reader-known timelines; after context compaction or a new session, writing picks right back up from disk. - **7 specialist roles and read/write gates** — dedicated subagents handle outlining, drafting, continuity checks, character design, research, manuscript search, and chapter extraction; long-form gates block drafting when a chapter outline is missing or previous state is uncommitted, and post-write checks catch cut-off endings, leaked outline jargon, and stock AI phrasing (references load on demand; see [Architecture & project layout](docs/architecture_EN.md) and [Knowledge base](docs/knowledge-base_EN.md)). - **Built for 7 coding agents** — Claude Code · Codex CLI · Google Antigravity · OpenCode · ZCode · OpenClaw · Reasonix; `/story-setup` deploys native subagents and hooks where supported, while any file-capable Web AI or agent environment can run the skills directly. - **Built for major Chinese fiction platforms** — Qidian (起点中文网), Fanqie (番茄小说), Jinjiang (晋江文学城), Qimao (七猫小说), and Ciweimao (刺猬猫) for serials; Zhihu Yanyan (知乎盐言故事), Fanqie Short-form, and Qimao Short-form for short stories. > **Trope = reliable emotional payoff** Start by **scanning charts** for trending premises, character archetypes, and opening angles, **deconstruct** how top books pace their opening three chapters, payoffs, and cliffhangers, then build your own story around clear hooks and anticipation. You make the creative calls; the agent executes the agreed plan. ## Installation ```bash npx skills add zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode -y -g ``` `-g` installs globally across directories; omit `-g` to install into the current directory only. **To update, run the same command again.** You can also ask your coding agent directly (works in any tool that imports GitHub repos or skills, such as WorkBuddy; see this [community walkthrough](https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2087452622655592204) in Chinese): ``` Install this skill https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode ``` Once installed, run `/story-setup` in your writing project root (`$story-setup` in Codex) to deploy the hooks, subagents, and references supported by your tool, **then start a fresh session**. You can also find the skills on [ClawHub](https://clawhub.ai/); published packages are listed in the [ClawHub inventory](.clawhub/publish.json). > Per-agent deployment details, known limits, and install troubleshooting (Windows `ENOENT`, Antigravity `agy -p`, leftover directories) are in **[Agent deployment and troubleshooting](docs/hosts_EN.md)**. Before drafting, only the state needed for the chapter—alongside its chapter outline, relevant world settings, and active character cards—goes to the writer rather than dumping the entire card into the prompt: ```markdown ## Current position - Chapter 20 · Volume 1 · Story time: the day after "如愿" passed 100M views ## Standing constraints - Propaganda payoffs must land through the work's real effect, reach data and bystander reaction — never through a system announcement alone. - Zhong Jiajia's undisclosed military background is author-truth; it cannot be treated as reader-known until the prose reveals it. ## Live foreshadowing - F016｜Zhong Jiajia is not an ordinary intern reporter｜planted ch.7｜payoff TBD｜high - F049｜Wu Wei has received a criminal summons; the legal outcome has not landed｜planted ch.18｜high - F054｜A veteran invited Jiang Chen to hear his story — an entry point for later work｜planted ch.20｜high ## Promises for the next chapter - Write the ch.21 blueprint first, then pick up the veteran's invitation, the new backing track and the piano skill. ``` **Author-truth and reader-known are tracked separately** so characters never know secrets early or spoil unrevealed clues. Scanning a hand-built AI-flavored passage catches 8 hits (3 blocking / 5 advisory): ```text 改前.md:7:20 [blocking] em-dash (么叫做命运的安排——不是巧合，而是一) 改前.md:23:6 [blocking] trailer-ending (才刚刚开始) 改前.md:25:1 [blocking] trailer-ending (没人知道) 改前.md:7:22 [advisory] not-is-comparison (不是巧合，而是一种冥冥之中的注定) 改前.md:11:1 [advisory] negation-parade (没有犹豫，没有生涩，) 改前.md:19:3 [advisory] voice-contrast (声音不大，却) 改前.md:21:2 [advisory] not-is-comparison (不是一次简单的弹奏，而是一场蓄谋已久的惊艳亮相) 改前.md:3:1 [advisory] cliche-density-tic (仿佛 一丝 深吸一口气 缓缓 微微) ``` Running the exact same scan on the corresponding scene in chapter 21 returns **zero hits, exit 0**. Both passages are nearly the same length: the before version tells the reader what to feel in abstract summary, while the rewrite puts character judgment, dialogue, and reactions directly on the page. Yes. Run `/story-setup` in the project root and start a fresh session, then run `/story-import` to reverse-parse your manuscript into settings, outlines, and tracking files; after reviewing its inferences, continue a serial with `/story-long-write 写第N章` (which drafts chapter N's outline first) or finish planning a short story before writing on. Inferences strictly follow manuscript evidence rather than guessing—see the [import-and-continue guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/import-and-continue). ### How does long-form writing avoid plot holes, dropped clues, or characters knowing too much? The project stores author-truth, reader-known facts, and per-character state separately on disk, feeding each chapter only the active state and open clues it needs before committing updates back through `_tracking-state.json`. See [Keep an AI-written novel consistent over 100+ chapters](docs/keep-ai-novel-consistent-over-100-chapters.md) for the repository mechanics and the [long-novel continuity guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/long-novel-continuity) for a three-chapter walkthrough. ### Why might external AI detectors still flag a chapter after `/story-deslop`? `/story-deslop` runs local lint scripts to catch stock AI phrasing, em-dash overuse, and repetition before rewriting abstract commentary back into concrete dialogue, decisions, and scene reactions. Its goal is natural readability for human readers—external detectors like Zhuque are only a rough reference; see the [revision guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/revise-ai-prose) and [in-repo lint details](docs/how-to-remove-ai-flavor-from-web-fiction.md) (Chinese). ### On Windows, installation prints `ENOENT ... mkdir` yet ends with `Done`. Did it work? Some skills were only partially unpacked. Re-run the exact same install command to repair the missing files; if any reference bundle is still incomplete, `/story-setup` will flag it explicitly. Codex users on Windows should also enable `core.symlinks=true` in Git. ### What should I do after upgrading or switching coding agents? Re-run the install command and start a fresh session. If the update changes project subagents, hooks, or reference bundles—or if you switch to another coding agent—run `/story-setup` once in your project root and open a new session; version-specific notes are in the [upgrade guide](skills/story-setup/UPGRADING.md) (Chinese). ## Acknowledgments - - - ## Part of ZenStory AI Oh Story is part of [ZenStory AI](https://zenstory.ai) — open-source tools for creating, adapting, and producing stories (GitHub org: [zenstory-ai](https://github.com/zenstory-ai)): | Project | What it does | | --- | --- | | [oh-story-claudecode](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode) | Web-fiction skill pack: chart scanning, deconstruction, outlining, long/short drafting, continuity tracking, de-AI-flavor polish, and covers (this repo) | | [drama-skills](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills) | AI short-drama & motion-comic skill suite: source/benchmark breakdown, scripts, visual settings, storyboards, image/video prompts, confirmed production, and final cuts | | [novel-to-game](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/novel-to-game) | Novel-to-game skill pack: source analysis, gameplay & art design, builds, and blind-playtest QA for web games, interactive films, and WeChat/Douyin/TapTap mini-games | | [video-recap-skills](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/video-recap-skills) | AI video-recap skill pack: auto shot-cutting, visual narration scripting, voiceover/mix with burned-in subtitles, and editable JianYing / CapCut draft export | | [oh-story-dsh](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-dsh) | Community DeepSeek Harness plugin bundling visual workbenches for novels, short dramas, games, and video recaps | | [zenstory](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/zenstory) | Chat-to-create AI web workbench for novels and short dramas ([app.zenstory.ai](https://app.zenstory.ai)) |
